sloka: अनुशिष्टो अस्मि अयोध्यायाम् गुरु मध्ये महात्मना ।पित्रा दशरथेन अहम् न अवज्ञेयम् च तद् वचः ॥१-२६-३॥
transliteration: anuśiṣṭo asmi ayodhyāyām guru madhye mahātmanā ।pitrā daśarathena aham na avajñeyam ca tad vacaḥ ॥1-26-3॥

translations.english: In Ayodhya in the presence of elders and spiritual masters (of Dasaratha's court), I have been ordered by my magnanimous father to act according to your instructions and his words cannot be disobeyed.
translations.hindi: श्रीरमचन्द्र जी के प्रश्‍न को सुन, महात्मा विश्वामित्र बोले-हे राघव ! सुनिए, में कहता हूँ, जिस प्रकार यह यक्षिणी इतनी बलवती हुई है
